system_a.summary: Guests describe a private, quiet basement apartment with its own entrance, in a scenic, hilly neighborhood roughly 10–20 minutes from downtown Asheville. Recurring praise includes good value, cleanliness, spaciousness, easy check-in, responsive hosts, a porch or deck, and convenience for road trips. Recent reviews (2024–2026) are mostly positive, emphasizing location, cleanliness, price, and communication, though many are brief and repetitive and add little detail. Reported limitations, mostly from earlier years, include a sagging bed, no curtains or blinds, a door that could not be locked, footsteps audible from upstairs, limited temperature control, and a steep driveway with a narrow path to the door. A recent 2024 review mentioned the uphill walk from parking being hard for older guests. Older reports of a toilet backup, spiders, and tense host communication are historical and may not reflect current conditions.

system_b.summary: Guests across 2014–2026 widely describe this basement unit as clean, quiet and good value, with easy check-in and a convenient location near Asheville and the Biltmore; several reviewers call it basic. Some 2025 reviews use near-identical wording, so they may not be independent confirmation. Concerns are mostly older: in 2015 and 2019 guests reported an unlockable entrance and missing window coverings, while others praised the private entrance and called the area safe. Single 2019 reports cite spiders, weak water pressure, a backed-up toilet, sagging beds and footsteps from above; 2017 reports mention stomping. Access involves a steep drive or uphill walk, and a 2024 reviewer found it challenging for older people. Hosts were mostly praised, including in 2026, though a few 2017–2019 guests found them aloof. Current conditions cannot be confirmed from these reviews.

selected_claims.claim: Guests broadly describe the unit as clean, with spotless or very clean reports across the full review history, including the most recent (2026). Two historical complaints: spiders in the bathroom (2019) and missing soap (2019).
selected_claims.time_qualification: Positive reports span 2014-2026; the two negatives are from 2019 only.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No evidence either 2019 issue persists or was resolved.

selected_claims.claim: Several early guests said the private entrance could not be locked and was left unlocked. One 2019 guest also reported no lock on the door to the upstairs or garage, a garage door left open for long periods, and advised removing valuables. Others still described the neighborhood as safe.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Lock concerns come from 2015 and 2019; none in recent years (2024-2026). Safe-neighborhood remarks come from 2015, 2020 and 2024.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Current door locking is unknown; no evidence of a change or of ongoing absence.

selected_claims.claim: Privacy concerns: windows had no curtains or blinds (2015, 2019 reviewers) and only a sheer in 2019. Elsewhere guests praised the private entrance, separate access and privacy from hosts.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Unknown whether window coverings have since been added.

selected_claims.claim: Access involves a steep, sometimes rocky driveway or hill, a narrow passage between staircase and wall to the door, and a distance from parking. One 2024 reviewer said the walk uphill can be challenging for older people. Another said a steep winding drive required low gear.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reports from 2017 to 2024, including the most recent (2024) accessibility concern.
selected_claims.uncertainty: A minority of reviewers; other guests found parking easy (2017, 2024).

selected_claims.claim: Noise from the host's living area above was reported by a few guests (footsteps audible; one 2017 guest reported stomping tied to a dispute). Most guests described the place as quiet, peaceful and restful.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Complaints from 2017 and 2019; quiet praise from 2014 to 2025.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Complaints are individual accounts; none appear recently.

selected_claims.claim: Two guests reported bed comfort problems (sagging, backaches), and others noted limited temperature control or a cool room. Most reviewers called the bed and space comfortable and spacious, though a few described it as basic or best for sleeping only.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Bed complaints 2018-2019; temperature remarks 2019 and 2022; comfort praise continues to 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Mattress may have been replaced; no evidence either way.

selected_claims.claim: A 2019 guest reported weak water pressure and a toilet that backed up nearly to overflowing. The same guest said the host blamed them. Another 2019 guest described a standoffish host message. No similar plumbing reports appear later.

Most guests praised hosts as responsive, friendly and communicative, including in 2026. A few reports describe an aloof or confrontational tone, a refused partial refund, and an extra-guest fee noticed late.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Negatives are few and individual accounts, not shown to be current.

selected_claims.claim: Check-in is widely described as easy, with clear instructions, a private or coded entry and little host contact needed. Minor issues: confusing house numbers, GPS errors, and a wish to drop belongings near the door.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Entry method may have changed over time.

selected_claims.claim: Listing is mostly reported as accurate. One 2019 guest said the patio differed from the photos. It is a basement unit with a private bath; several reviewers called it basic or no-frills.

Location and price are heavily praised: close to Asheville, Biltmore and highway access, quiet setting, and good value. Several recent 2025 reviews use near-identical wording, so they may not be independent corroboration.

selected_claims.uncertainty: Mild drive distance to downtown mentioned (10-20 min); repeated phrasing reduces independence.
